api.output_storage: private Files API storage; no public URL requested

generation_workflow.continuity: Each continuation segment pins its first frame to the previous segment's extracted final frame; SHA-256 pixel-frame checks are required at every boundary.
generation_workflow.note: Reference-to-video is limited to 720p. The 1080p delivery is an upscale and must be visually reviewed; it is not native 1080p.

temporary_file_policy.note: Temporary xAI files are private and expire after seven days; canonical production media must be preserved in Dropbox.

fallback_policy: Never substitute still-image slideshows, stock clips, Blender placeholder motion, fabricated provider job records, or another video provider for real xAI-generated video without explicit user approval.
